test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 5 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All rats are cats.

All cats are tigers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some tigers are rats.

II. All rats are tigers.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn Diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/334bfa7a2de775d0340f3b017bae088bf51b1ea07194ef706f2f4c00a162de79.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some tigers are rats. → Follows (because all rats are cats and all cats are tigers, hence some tigers are definitely rats as can be seen from the above diagram.)

II. All rats are tigers. → Follows (because all rats are cats and all cats are tigers, so all rats are tigers.)

Hence, “Both conclusions I and II follow”.
